      :doc "A scan positioned at the lower bound of the query through the real cursor steps delivers the run's entries in key order, across pages and levels, and ends exactly when they do.")
    `(defthm-owed ,(fn2-columns-sym name "-OVERLAY-SORTED") (entries)
      (implies (fn2-ov-inputp ,layout ',key entries)
               (equal (fn2-ov-image ,id ,layout entries) (fn2-ov-image-spec ',key entries)))
      :teeth (,(fn2-columns-sym name "-OVERLAY-SORTED-POSITIVE") ,(fn2-columns-sym name "-OVERLAY-SORTED-NEGATIVE"))
      :schema :g1 :claim :representation :shared ((:schema ,name))
      :doc "Entries inserted into the active overlay in any order through the real insert all succeed when their keys are distinct, and read back in key order.")
    (fn2-ra-keystone-events (cdr rows))))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The glue check. A schema's build and lookup path is the generic entry
; points, the dispatcher, its codecs and key order, every function its
; declaration generated, and any per-schema glue by the old names that
; exists. Each must be :common-lisp-compliant, or the schema is refused by
; name: (:unverified schema function). The snapshot pairs each schema with
; (function . symbol-class) for its path, taken from the world.
(defconst *fn2-run-glue-generic*
 '(fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-decode fn2-run-layout-encode
   fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-layout-compare fn2-run-add-ready fn2-run-add-write fn2-run-add fn2-run-seek fn2-run-build-add
   fn2-run-build-promote fn2-run-build-work fn2-run-build-start fn2-run-build-page fn2-run-build-finish
   fn2-run-skip fn2-run-nth fn2-run-step-header fn2-run-step-seek fn2-run-step-child fn2-run-step-deliver fn2-run-step-up fn2-run-phase-header fn2-run-phase-seek fn2-run-phase-child fn2-run-phase-deliver fn2-run-phase-up fn2-run-cursor-step fn2-run-lookup-step fn2-run-scan-step fn2-ov-entry fn2-ov-order fn2-ov-search fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-write fn2-ov-insert fn2-ov-start fn2-ov-place fn2-ov-reput fn2-ov-insert-at fn2-run-cursor-start fn2-run-cache-install))
(defconst *fn2-run-glue-old-suffixes*
 '("-ENTRY-ADD" "-INDEX-ADD" "-ENTRY-SEEK" "-INDEX-SEEK" "-BUILD-ADD" "-BUILD-PROMOTE"
   "-INDEX-SKIP" "-INDEX-NTH" "-LOOKUP-STEP"))
(defun fn2-ra-sym-list (name suffixes)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom suffixes) nil (cons (fn2-columns-sym name (car suffixes)) (fn2-ra-sym-list name (cdr suffixes)))))
(defun fn2-ra-existing-old (names world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom names) nil
  (if (function-symbolp (car names) world) (cons (car names) (fn2-ra-existing-old (cdr names) world))
    (fn2-ra-existing-old (cdr names) world))))
(defun fn2-ra-generated-functions (manifest)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom manifest) nil
  (if (eq (caar manifest) :function) (cons (cadar manifest) (fn2-ra-generated-functions (cdr manifest)))
    (fn2-ra-generated-functions (cdr manifest)))))
(defun fn2-ra-classes (names world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom names) nil
  (cons (cons (car names) (getpropc (car names) 'symbol-class nil world)) (fn2-ra-classes (cdr names) world))))
; The first function of PAIRS that is not guard-verified, or nil.
(defun fn2-run-glue-unverified (pairs)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (cond ((atom pairs) nil)
       ((and (consp (car pairs)) (eq (cdar pairs) :common-lisp-compliant)) (fn2-run-glue-unverified (cdr pairs)))
       (t (if (consp (car pairs)) (caar pairs) (car pairs)))))
(defun fn2-run-glue-check (snapshot)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (cond ((atom snapshot) :ok)
       ((not (consp (car snapshot))) (list :unverified nil nil))
       ((fn2-run-glue-unverified (cdar snapshot)) (list :unverified (caar snapshot) (fn2-run-glue-unverified (cdar snapshot))))
       (t (fn2-run-glue-check (cdr snapshot)))))
(defun fn2-ra-glue-names (name row world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((layouts (fn2-decl-get :layouts row)))
  (append *fn2-run-glue-generic*
          (list (fn2-columns-sym (car layouts) "-ENCODE") (fn2-columns-sym (car layouts) "-DECODE")
                (fn2-columns-sym (car layouts) "-SIZE") (fn2-columns-sym (cadr layouts) "-ENCODE")
                (fn2-columns-sym (cadr layouts) "-DECODE") (fn2-columns-sym (cadr layouts) "-SIZE")
                (fn2-decl-get :compare row))
          (fn2-ra-generated-functions (fn2-decl-get :generated row))
          (fn2-ra-existing-old (fn2-ra-sym-list name *fn2-run-glue-old-suffixes*) world))))
(defun fn2-ra-glue-snapshot (rows world)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom rows) nil
  (cons (cons (caar rows) (fn2-ra-classes (fn2-ra-glue-names (caar rows) (cdar rows) world) world))
        (fn2-ra-glue-snapshot (cdr rows) world))))
;; One assembly per world, after its last schema. The owed row records the
;; certify-time check; its teeth: the assembled schemas pass, and a schema
;; carrying per-schema glue admitted without guard verification is refused
;; by name.
;; The generated proofs run in one theory, whatever the including world's.
;; deflayout disables the fields and pool accessors locally in each codec's
;; book; a world that includes a schema's certified book has them enabled
;; again, and the assembly's proofs there took ten times as long (159 s
;; against 17 s). The assembly folds the same accessors, and the rows
;; accessors of the digest and checker tables, as runs.lisp does.
(defmacro fn2-run-assembly-theory ()
 '(local (in-theory (disable fn2-fieldsp fn2-poolp fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields-value fn2-fields-ref-slot
                             fn2-fields-ref-gen fn2-fields-ref-off fn2-fields-ref-len fn2-fields-status fn2-pool-rows
                             fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write fn2-fields-decode-phase fn2-fields-decode-pos fn2-fields-decode-acc
                             fn2-fields-decode-high fn2-fields-decode-size fn2-fields-decode-ref fn2-fields-decode-payload
                             fn2-fields-decode-next fn2-digests-rows fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc-context-rows fn2-b3-rows))))
(defmacro fn2-run-assemble ()
 '(encapsulate ()
   (fn2-run-assembly-theory)
   (make-event
    (if (fn2-rs-assembled (w state))
        (er soft 'fn2-run-assemble "The runs are already assembled: ~x0." (fn2-rs-assembled (w state)))
      (value `(table fn2-run-assembly :schemas ',(strip-cars (fn2-decl-rows :schema (w state))))))
    :check-expansion t)
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-ra-dispatch-events (fn2-decl-rows :schema (w state))))))
   (fn2-ra-shape-events)
   (fn2-ra-page-events)
   (fn2-ra-build-events)
   (fn2-ra-lookup-events)
   (fn2-ra-overlay-events)
   (fn2-ra-adapter-events)
   (fn2-ra-overlay-adapter-events)
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-ra-keystone-events (fn2-decl-rows :schema (w state))))))
   (make-event
    (value `(defun fn2-run-glue-assembled ()
              (declare (xargs :guard t))
              ',(fn2-ra-glue-snapshot (fn2-decl-rows :schema (w state)) (w state)))))
   (defthm-owed fn2-run-glue-verified ()
    (equal (fn2-run-glue-check (fn2-run-glue-assembled)) :ok)
    :teeth (fn2-run-glue-verified-positive fn2-run-glue-verified-negative)
    :schema :invariant
    :doc "Every assembled schema's build and lookup path (generic entry points, dispatcher, codecs, key order, generated functions, any per-schema glue) is guard-verified; the assembly refuses otherwise, by name.")
   (make-event
    (let ((r (fn2-run-glue-check (fn2-run-glue-assembled))))
     (if (eq r :ok) (value '(value-triple :glue-verified))
       (er soft 'fn2-run-assemble "Run schema ~x0: ~x1 is not guard-verified." (cadr r) (caddr r)))))))
before.machines-c-read:
; Layer C in the served core, seam C-S4's first half (docs/c-ordered-runs.md
; §8 item 12; docs/d-machines-nntp.md §15.8): served reads for layer D's
; query cursor rows. Written by D on C's ruling (C and B read the diff), as
; machines-c-groups.lisp is written, to C's binding amendments (a)-(e):
;
; (a) Read row X (two per query cursor slot, one per consumer request:
;     (fn2-b-read-rows profile) of
;     them) owns a field stripe of *fn2-read-stride* rows below the sealer's
;     stripe, which sits below the transactions' stripes anchored at the
;     table's end: base(X) = rows - 1024*t - *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* -
;     *fn2-b-read-stride**(X+1); B's per-slot stripes lie at or below the
;     lowest read stripe. In a stripe: the lo key at +0, the hi key at +80,
;     the decoded heads of the range's eight sources from +160 (the exact
;     lookup decodes into source 0's region: a row runs one read at a time).
;     The row's other state: range row X of fn2-ranges, sources [8X, 8X+8)
;     of fn2-range-sources, seek row X of fn2-seeks, the exact lookup's
;     continuation in transaction row t+X of fn2-succ-txns with run cursor
;     t+X (fn2-xl-step serves it unchanged: the generalization by
;     allocation of §15.9), the sources' run cursors t+R+8X+i.
; (b) Staleness. The sealer moves an overlay into a run and frees its arena
;     in one step between any two of a reader's steps. Every continuation is
;     re-checked at each step: a range or seek re-finds every source strictly
;     after its resume key when the schema's run version moved
;     (fn2-range-step) or when an overlay source no longer holds the taking
;     it located (its row's phase, schema and SEQ: a SEQ is issued once per
;     taking, so it names the arena's life; fn2-rd-sources-live); the exact
;     lookup re-reads its overlay leg each call and restarts its run leg on a
;     version move (fn2-xl-step). A delivered entry is read (fn2-read-value,
;     fn2-read-octets) only while its schema's run version is the one it was
;     delivered under, else :stale: no read touches a freed arena. :miss
;     keeps its word though resident pages cannot raise it before M2.
; (c) fn2-read-frontier: the view a connection pins, C's :published
;     position (fn2-id-engine, written by fn2-succ-publish as max(published,
;     batch cov)), read through C's fn2-successor-published; (mv code
;     position), every published batch at or below the position.
; (d) LIST's whole-schema ordered scan (fn2-read-scan, -scan-next): the
;     range read's sources and merge over any schema, octet keys included,
;     its resume key the delivered key itself (copied into the caller's
;     workspace), skipped once by the next step; never an octet-keyed range.
; (e) The identity read (fn2-read-identity), rewritten by C over §4a's
;     records: two exact lookups of the name (the article index, then the
;     summary), answering (:found article), :evidence or :absent and the
;     locally known other candidates.
;
; Every operation is (... fn2-core) with a defcost; the core wrappers are
; fn2-read-core-events, materialized in assembly-callbacks-c.lisp.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-sealer")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The stripe.
(defconst *fn2-read-sources* 8)
(defconst *fn2-read-lo* 0)
(defconst *fn2-read-hi* *fn2-run-entry-rows*)
(defconst *fn2-read-heads* (* 2 *fn2-run-entry-rows*))
(defconst *fn2-read-stride* (+ *fn2-read-heads* (* *fn2-read-sources* *fn2-run-reader-fields*)))
(assert-event (and (<= *fn2-read-stride* *fn2-b-read-stride*) (<= *fn2-b-read-stride* 1024)
                   (equal (fn2-b-read-rows '((:x . 4))) 0) (equal (fn2-b-read-rows '((:x . 4) (:reading . t))) 8)
                   (equal (fn2-b-read-rows '((:x . 4) (:reading . t) (:cns . 3))) 11)
                   (equal (fn2-b-field-rows '((:t . 3) (:x . 2) (:reading . t) (:format-slots . 3)))
                          (+ (* 3 *fn2-idc-b-stripe*) (* 3 *fn2-idc-stride*) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows* (* 4 *fn2-b-read-stride*)))))

; A read row: the operation it holds (one at a time), the schema, the
; owner its octet key fields are read under (QSET once given), and the
; delivered entry (ENTRY: its rows at EROW, octets readable under EK ES EG,
; delivered under the schema's run version EVER).
; A scan (C-S4 (d)) keeps its resume key in the lo region, its octets in
; the caller's workspace WSLOT/WGEN (under the query owner), EXCL once a key
; was delivered (the next step skips it); the identity read (C-S4 (e)) its
; lookup (SID: the article index, then the summary), FOUND and the article
; (SELECTED) once the index answered.
(defcolumns fn2-reads
 ((op (:enum fn2-read-op (:idle :lookup :range :seek :scan :identity)))
  (sid :u60) (qset :bool) (qk :u8) (qs :u32) (qg :u60)
  (entry :bool) (erow :u32) (ek :u8) (es :u32) (eg :u60) (ever :u60)
  (wslot :u32) (wgen :u60) (excl :bool) (found :bool) (selected :u60) (evidence :u32)))

; The read rows' children, their inits' guards proved once over their own
; profile predicate (the transaction-sized children's is fn2-idc-profilep).
(defun fn2-read-profilep (profile)
 (declare (xargs :guard t))
 (unsigned-byte-p 32 (* *fn2-read-sources* (+ 1 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)))))
(defmacro fn2-read-child (field stobj init why)
 (let ((fn (fn2-columns-sym stobj "-INIT-FOR")))
  `(progn
    (defun ,fn (profile ,stobj)
     (declare (xargs :stobjs ,stobj :guard (fn2-read-profilep profile)
                     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-read-profilep)))))
     ,init)
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-TYPE")
     (implies (and (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") ,stobj) (fn2-read-profilep profile))
              (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "P") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-read-profilep))))
    (defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-WFP")
     (implies (fn2-read-profilep profile) (,(fn2-columns-sym stobj "-WFP") (,fn profile ,stobj)))
     :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable fn2-read-profilep))))
    (in-theory (disable ,fn))
    (defcorechild ,field ,stobj :init (,fn profile ,stobj) :profilep (fn2-read-profilep profile) :why ,why))))
(in-theory (disable fn2-read-profilep))
(fn2-read-child fn2-core-reads fn2-reads (fn2-reads-init (fn2-b-read-rows profile) fn2-reads)
 "One read row per query cursor slot (C-S4): its operation, its query owner and its delivered entry survive the cursor's yields.")
(assert-event (equal *fn2-read-sources* *fn2-idc-seal-cursors*))
(fn2-read-child fn2-core-ranges fn2-ranges (fn2-ranges-init (+ 1 (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) fn2-ranges)
 "Read row X's range read (C3) resumes from its resume key across the cursor's yields; row R (after the R read rows) is the sealer's merge (C5).")
(fn2-read-child fn2-core-range-sources fn2-range-sources
 (fn2-range-sources-init (* *fn2-read-sources* (+ 1 (fn2-b-read-rows profile))) fn2-range-sources)
 "Read row X's range sources [8X, 8X+8): one per overlay or live run of the schema; [8R, 8R+8) the sealer merge's.")
(fn2-read-child fn2-core-seeks fn2-seeks (fn2-seeks-init (fn2-b-read-rows profile) fn2-seeks)
 "Read row X's positioned seek (INBOX 4.1) over its range row.")

; Read row X's stripe base, or :bounds when X is no read row or B's
; stripes (FCROWS format slots) would reach the lowest read stripe.
(defun fn2-read-stripe (x fcrows fn2-reads fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-reads fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (let* ((n (fn2-reads-rows fn2-reads)) (tn (fn2-id-decides-rows fn2-id-decides)) (rows (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
        (top (- (nfix rows) (+ (* *fn2-idc-stride* (nfix tn)) *fn2-b-seal-field-rows*))))
  (if (and (natp x) (< x (nfix n)) (<= (+ (* *fn2-idc-b-stripe* (nfix fcrows)) (* *fn2-b-read-stride* (nfix n))) top))
      (mv :ok (- top (* *fn2-b-read-stride* (+ x 1))))
    (mv :bounds 0))))
(defthm fn2-read-stripe-natp (natp (mv-nth 1 (fn2-read-stripe x fcrows fn2-reads fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)))
 :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(in-theory (disable fn2-read-stripe))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Shapes (type, wfp and rows of every stobj a function returns), proved
; right after each function with it opened and its callees folded.
(defun fn2-rd-shape-disables (stobjs)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom stobjs) nil (cons (fn2-columns-sym (car stobjs) "-ROWS") (fn2-rd-shape-disables (cdr stobjs)))))
;; READS entries (:keep F) leave F enabled (a stobj's -ROWS where an
;; element is read from a stobj the function also writes).
(defun fn2-rd-keeps (reads)

 (cond ((atom reads) nil) ((consp (car reads)) (cons (car reads) (fn2-rd-keeps (cdr reads)))) (t (fn2-rd-keeps (cdr reads)))))
(defun fn2-rd-folds (reads)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((atom reads) nil) ((consp (car reads)) (fn2-rd-folds (cdr reads))) (t (cons (car reads) (fn2-rd-folds (cdr reads))))))
;; Every stobj's -ROWS folded (the shape lemmas and the reads' guards are
;; stated over it), the fields and pool recognizers folded (C-ASSEMBLY-THEORY),
;; and READS: the callees and the row reads whose values only feed checks

    (implies (and ,@(fn2-idc-hyp-list stobjs)) (and ,@(fn2-fc-shape-claims outs (cons fn args))))

                                    fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-poolp fn2-pool-wfp ,@(fn2-rd-folds reads))))))
   ,@(and disable `((in-theory (disable ,fn))))))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Keys. Integer key field J (below *fn2-run-entry-rows*) of REGION (:lo or
; :hi) of read row X (stripe B0) takes VALUE; a key written ends the row's
; operation (its continuation is over a key it no longer holds).
(defun fn2-rd-key (x region j value b0 fn2-reads fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-reads fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-reads-wfp fn2-reads) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields))) (mv :state fn2-reads fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp x) (< x (fn2-reads-rows fn2-reads)) (natp b0) (natp j) (< j *fn2-run-entry-rows*)
                    (member-eq region '(:lo :hi)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 value)
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-read-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       (mv :bounds fn2-reads fn2-fields))
      (row (+ b0 (if (eq region :lo) *fn2-read-lo* *fn2-read-hi*) j))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put row (value value) (ref-slot 0) (ref-gen 0) (ref-off 0) (ref-len 0)))
      (fn2-reads (fn2-reads-put x (op *fn2-read-op-idle*) (entry 0))))

;; Each child operation keeps every child it returns well formed (the type,
;; the invariant and the row count), so a child-form arm's shape follows
;; (MACHINE-FORM 6.5 P3: the cursor's arms call these directly).
(defun fn2-read-child-hyps (ins)
  (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
  (if (atom ins) nil
    (if (car ins)
        (list* (list (fn2-columns-sym (car ins) "P") (car ins)) (list (fn2-columns-sym (car ins) "-WFP") (car ins))
               (fn2-read-child-hyps (cdr ins)))
      (fn2-read-child-hyps (cdr ins)))))
(defun fn2-read-child-rows (ins)
  (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
  (if (atom ins) nil
    (if (car ins) (cons (fn2-columns-sym (car ins) "-ROWS") (fn2-read-child-rows (cdr ins)))
      (fn2-read-child-rows (cdr ins)))))
(defun fn2-read-child-facts (fn call outs i hyps rows)
  (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
  (if (atom outs) nil
    (append
     (and (car outs)
          (let ((r `(mv-nth ,i ,call)) (st (car outs)))
            `((defthm ,(fn2-columns-sym fn (concatenate 'string "-" (symbol-name st) "-PRESERVED"))
                (implies (and ,@hyps)
                         (and (,(fn2-columns-sym st "P") ,r) (,(fn2-columns-sym st "-WFP") ,r)
                              (equal (,(fn2-columns-sym st "-ROWS") ,r) (,(fn2-columns-sym st "-ROWS") ,st))))
                :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (e/d (,fn) (,@rows))))))))
     (fn2-read-child-facts fn call (cdr outs) (+ 1 i) hyps rows))))
(defun fn2-read-children-facts (fns world)
  (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
  (if (atom fns) nil
    (let* ((fn (car fns)) (formals (getpropc fn 'formals nil world))
           (ins (getpropc fn 'stobjs-in nil world)) (outs (getpropc fn 'stobjs-out nil world)))
      (append (fn2-read-child-facts fn (cons fn formals) outs 0 (fn2-read-child-hyps ins) (fn2-read-child-rows ins))
              (fn2-read-children-facts (cdr fns) world)))))
(make-event
 (cons 'progn
       (fn2-read-children-facts
        '(fn2-read-key-children fn2-read-key-octets-children fn2-read-lookup-children fn2-read-range-children
          fn2-read-next-children fn2-read-seek-children fn2-read-seek-step-children fn2-read-octets-children
          fn2-read-release-children fn2-read-scan-children fn2-read-scan-next-children fn2-read-identity-children)
        (w state))))

before.machines-c-successor:
; Layer C in the served core, seam C-S3 (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §8 item 8):
; every engine write of a transaction goes through its batch's private
; successor. A transaction's write slots are declared at :prepare (put, arg,
; arg-octets, resolve); in its :ready arm, in one transition, stage computes
; every slot's row against the tip and holds room, out reads an assigned
; value, B admits the member, and bind writes every row into the batch's
; private overlays; release frees the slots at the outcome. B's commit kind
; publishes a batch (its private overlays, of every schema, readable in one
; step) or drops it. The tables, the engine row, the defcosts and the core
; wrappers (fn2-successor-prepare-events and -commit-events, materialized in
; assembly-callbacks-c-prepare and -commit) are three books': this one holds the tables,
; the declaring calls (put, arg, arg-octets) and resolve; machines-c-stage
; stage and out; machines-c-bind bind, release, publication, the defcosts
; and the wrappers (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-sealer-kind")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
;; The assembly's dispatchers case-split over every schema id when open; the
;; successor treats them as opaque (their type facts are the assembly's).
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; C-ENGINE-OWNER (as built, C1c): the engine's workspaces (overlay arenas,
; the bind scratch, the sealer's pages) are owned by the sealer machine's row:
; kind = fn2-sealer's position in the registry (the index's *FN2-SEALER-KIND*,
; asserted equal in machines-c-sealer.lisp), local slot 0, generation 1. The
; local slot, not the global id, because these constants are used before the
; index exists.
(make-event (value `(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-kind*
                     ,(let ((pos (position-eq 'fn2-sealer (fn2-machine-names (w state))))) (if (natp pos) pos 254)))))
(assert-event (not (equal *fn2-idc-owner-kind* 254)))
(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-slot* 0)
(defconst *fn2-idc-owner-gen* 1)
; The bind scratch takes one slot's octets at a time: an entry's octet
; fields in field order from 0.
(defconst *fn2-idc-scratch-bytes* 4096)

; A write slot's block of field rows (C-STRIPE): the staged row at +0 (key
; fields then value fields, at most 12), the args as given at +12 (a value,
; a packed handle for :out, an octet reference), the args evaluated at +24
; (a fold's event args), the key's row
; read from the installed runs at +36 (its value fields, at most 8).
(defconst *fn2-succ-entry* 0)
(defconst *fn2-succ-raw* 12)
(defconst *fn2-succ-eval* 24)
(defconst *fn2-succ-res* 36)
; Row 44 of a staged slot's block: 1 when stage found it fresh (an insert
; new at the tip, a fold step applied), 0 when it binds nothing (a :union
; key already present, a fold :unchanged). An arg (:new K) reads it.
(defconst *fn2-succ-fresh* 44)
(defconst *fn2-succ-fields-max* 12)
(defconst *fn2-succ-values-max* 8)
(assert-event (<= (+ *fn2-succ-res* *fn2-succ-values-max*) *fn2-succ-fresh*))
(assert-event (< *fn2-succ-fresh* *fn2-succ-block*))

;; Every assembled schema fits a slot: at most 12 entry fields and, for a
;; fold, 8 value fields and 12 args per event kind; its octet fields fit the
;; bind scratch together.
(defun fn2-succ-kinds-fit (sid kinds)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom kinds) (and (<= (nfix (fn2-fold-arity sid (car kinds))) *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (fn2-succ-kinds-fit sid (cdr kinds)))))
(defun fn2-succ-octets-total (sid f n)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil :measure (nfix (- (nfix n) (nfix f)))))
 (if (<= (nfix n) (nfix f)) 0 (+ (nfix (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid f)) (fn2-succ-octets-total sid (+ 1 (nfix f)) n))))
(defun fn2-succ-schemas-fit (ids)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (or (atom ids)
     (let* ((sid (car ids)) (nf (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0)))
      (and (<= nf *fn2-succ-fields-max*)
           (or (not (fn2-run-layout-fold-p sid)) (<= (- nf (fn2-run-layout-keys sid)) *fn2-succ-values-max*))
           (fn2-succ-kinds-fit sid *fn2-run-fold-kinds*)
           (<= (fn2-succ-octets-total sid 0 nf) *fn2-idc-scratch-bytes*)
           (fn2-succ-schemas-fit (cdr ids))))))
(assert-event (fn2-succ-schemas-fit *fn2-run-assembled-ids*))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Tables. The engine row: the bind scratch (held once taken), the arena
; size, the next overlay sequence number. A transaction row (one per
; transaction, as its decision row): its phase, its batch and commit
; position once bound,
; resolve's progress (slot RI, run bound RBOUND), and an exact lookup's
; (machines-c-groups.lisp: LPHASE, LBOUND, LROW, LVER). A slot row (row
; T * 24 + I): schema, kind (:insert, or one of the folds' event
; kinds), the masks of args given (SET), given :event (EVENTS) and given
; :out (OUTS), what resolve found (FOUND, the schema's run version VRUN), the
; staged entry's SIZE, the owner its octet args are read under, the args
; declared late (LATE, C-S3a: octets given between stage and bind) and the
; late args filled since the last stage (FILLED).
; PUBLISHED: the greatest commit position publication has made readable
; (C-S4 amendment (c): D's frontier reads it, never derives it from overlays).
(defcolumns fn2-id-engine ((scratch :bool) (slot :u32) (gen :u60) (arena :u32) (seq :u60) (published :u60)))
(defun fn2-id-engine-init-arena (bytes fn2-id-engine)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-id-engine :guard (unsigned-byte-p 32 bytes)))
 (let ((fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-init 1 fn2-id-engine)))
  (fn2-id-engine-set-arena 0 bytes fn2-id-engine)))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-id-engine fn2-id-engine (fn2-id-engine-init-arena (fn2-b-capacity :identity-arena-bytes 65536 profile) fn2-id-engine)
 "The engine's bind scratch, arena size and overlay sequence (C-S3).")
(defcolumns fn2-succ-txns
 ((phase (:enum fn2-succ-phase (:idle :open :staged :bound :published)))
  (batch :u60) (event :u60)
  (ri :u32) (rstate (:enum fn2-succ-resolve (:fresh :next :look))) (rbound :u60)
  (lphase (:enum fn2-succ-lookup (:idle :overlays :runs :scan))) (lbound :u60) (lrow :u32) (lver :u60)))
(make-event
 `(defcolumns fn2-succ-slots
   ((phase (:enum fn2-succ-slot-phase (:empty :put :resolved)))
    (sid :u60) (kind (:enum fn2-succ-kind ,(append (cons :insert *fn2-run-fold-kinds*) '(:depend))))
    (set :u32) (events :u32) (outs :u32) (found :bool) (vrun :u60) (size :u32)
    (oset :bool) (sk :u8) (ss :u32) (sg :u60) (late :u32) (filled :u32) (unchanged :bool))))
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-succ-txns
 (fn2-succ-txns-init (+ (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile)) (fn2-b-read-rows profile)) fn2-succ-txns)
 "A transaction's writes survive its yields between :prepare and its outcome (C-S3); then one row per read row, its exact lookup's continuation (C-S4).")
(fn2-idc-child fn2-core-succ-slots fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-init (* *fn2-succ-slots* (nfix (fn2-profile-t profile))) fn2-succ-slots)
 "Each transaction's write slots (C-S3).")

; The first overlay row at or after O in phase PHASE (and, for a private
; one, of batch B); past the last, the row count.
(defun fn2-idc-find-overlay (k o phase b fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp k))))
 (cond ((not (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)) (posp k))) (nfix (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))
       ((and (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) phase)
             (or (not (equal phase *fn2-overlay-phase-private*)) (equal (fn2-overlays-batch o fn2-overlays) b)))
        o)
       (t (fn2-idc-find-overlay (- k 1) (+ 1 o) phase b fn2-overlays))))
(defthm fn2-idc-find-overlay-natp (natp (fn2-idc-find-overlay k o phase b fn2-overlays)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(defun fn2-idc-count-overlays (k o phase fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp k))))
 (cond ((not (and (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)) (posp k))) 0)
       (t (+ (if (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) phase) 1 0)
             (fn2-idc-count-overlays (- k 1) (+ 1 o) phase fn2-overlays)))))
(defthm fn2-idc-count-overlays-natp (natp (fn2-idc-count-overlays k o phase fn2-overlays)) :rule-classes :type-prescription)

;; Shapes of the operations the successor uses (type, wfp, rows of every
;; stobj each returns), proved here once, each operation opened alone; READS
;; are folded (C-SHAPE-READS).
(defun fn2-idc-op-shape-disables (plain reads)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (cond ((eq plain :min) `(fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlay-index-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-pool-rows ,@reads))
       (plain `(fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlay-index-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-pool-rows
                fn2-id-engine-rows fn2-id-decides-rows
                fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-run-cursors-rows
                fn2-run-paths-rows fn2-run-installed-rows
                fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read
                fn2-pool-write fn2-pool-class-for ,@reads))
       (t `(fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlay-indexp fn2-overlay-index-wfp
            fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields-wfp fn2-poolp fn2-pool-wfp fn2-overlays-rows
            fn2-overlay-index-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-pool-rows
            fn2-pool-reserve fn2-pool-release fn2-pool-reset fn2-pool-read fn2-pool-write
            fn2-pool-class-for fn2-id-enginep fn2-id-engine-wfp fn2-id-engine-rows
            fn2-id-decidesp fn2-id-decides-wfp fn2-id-decides-rows ,@reads))))
;; One theorem per operation (machines.lisp fn2-shape-one): the claims about
;; every returned child are one predicate, proved by one walk of the
;; operation's paths; FN-IDC-SHAPE states the claims, for callers.
(defmacro fn2-idc-op-shape (fn args outs hyps &optional (plain 'nil) reads)
 (let ((outputs (if (consp (car outs)) outs (fn2-idc-shape-outs outs 1))))
  `(fn2-shape-one ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-IDC-SHAPE") ,fn ,args ,hyps
                  ,(fn2-fc-shape-claims outputs 'fn2-shape-r) ,(strip-cars outputs)
                  (,fn) ,(fn2-idc-op-shape-disables plain reads))))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-ov-start (o schema slot gen ibase icap okind oslot ogen cov fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-pool)
 (fn2-overlays fn2-pool) ((fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-ov-advance (o from to fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays) ((fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays)))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-ov-write (o pos ebase repl fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-pool)
 ((fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlay-indexp fn2-overlay-index)
  (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index) (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))
 nil (fn2-ov-okp fn2-overlays-schema fn2-overlays-fill fn2-overlays-cap fn2-overlays-slot fn2-overlays-gen
      fn2-overlays-okind fn2-overlays-oslot fn2-overlays-ogen fn2-run-layout-size))
(fn2-idc-op-shape fn2-ov-insert (o ebase eb fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool) (fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 ((fn2-overlaysp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlay-indexp fn2-overlay-index)
  (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index) (fn2-fieldsp fn2-fields) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-poolp fn2-pool) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))
 nil (fn2-ov-okp fn2-overlays-phase fn2-overlays-okind fn2-overlays-oslot fn2-overlays-ogen fn2-overlays-count
      fn2-overlays-icap fn2-overlays-schema fn2-run-layout-merge))
(in-theory (disable fn2-ov-start fn2-ov-advance))

;; Each function's output shapes (type, wfp, rows), proved right after it.
(defun fn2-idc-hyp-list (stobjs)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom stobjs) nil
  (list* `(,(fn2-columns-sym (car stobjs) "P") ,(car stobjs)) `(,(fn2-columns-sym (car stobjs) "-WFP") ,(car stobjs))
         (fn2-idc-hyp-list (cdr stobjs)))))
(defmacro fn2-idc-fn-shape (fn args outs stobjs &optional (mode 't) reads)
 `(progn (fn2-idc-op-shape ,fn ,args ,outs ,(fn2-idc-hyp-list stobjs) ,mode ,reads)
         (in-theory (disable ,fn))))
; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Field-row helpers.

; Copy row FROM to row TO (value and reference; the codec's resume columns
; are scratch); N rows FROM.. to TO...
(defun fn2-succ-copy-row (from to fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp from) (natp to))))
 (if (not (and (natp from) (natp to) (< from (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (< to (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))) fn2-fields
  (fn2-fields-put to (value (fn2-fields-value from fn2-fields)) (ref-slot (fn2-fields-ref-slot from fn2-fields))
                  (ref-gen (fn2-fields-ref-gen from fn2-fields)) (ref-off (fn2-fields-ref-off from fn2-fields))
                  (ref-len (fn2-fields-ref-len from fn2-fields)) (status (fn2-fields-status from fn2-fields)))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-copy-row (from to fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t)

; Slot I of transaction TX writes schema SID by KIND: a fold event kind of
; SID, or :insert (a whole entry of a :unique, :latest or :union schema that
; is not a fold); or reads it by :depend, the transaction's read dependency
; (EXCELLENCE-ASTRA section 1B): a whole entry of a fold, :unique or :latest
; schema, its key and the value fields the transaction decided on, all
; integers given as values; stage answers :changed unless the key's row at
; the tip (the immediate predecessor's, an earlier prepared batch's
; included) holds exactly those values, and the slot binds nothing. Any change to a transaction's slots leaves it :open (stage
; again) and restarts resolve.
(defun fn2-succ-put (tx i sid kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) :guard t))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots))) (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*)
                    (< (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i) (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 sid)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (member (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns)
                       (list *fn2-succ-phase-idle* *fn2-succ-phase-open* *fn2-succ-phase-staged*)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      (code (fn2-succ-kind-keyword->code kind))
      ((unless (natp code)) (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (< 0 (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0))) (mv :schema fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (cond ((equal code *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)
                      (and (not (fn2-run-layout-fold-p sid)) (member-eq (fn2-run-layout-merge sid) '(:unique :latest :union))))
                     ((equal code *fn2-succ-kind-depend*)
                      (or (fn2-run-layout-fold-p sid) (member-eq (fn2-run-layout-merge sid) '(:unique :latest))))
                     (t (natp (fn2-fold-arity sid kind)))))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i))
      (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-put s (phase *fn2-succ-slot-phase-put*) (sid sid) (kind code) (set 0) (events 0) (outs 0)
                                          (found 0) (vrun 0) (size 0) (oset 0) (sk 0) (ss 0) (sg 0) (late 0) (filled 0) (unchanged 0)))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (phase *fn2-succ-phase-open*) (ri 0)
                                        (rstate *fn2-succ-resolve-fresh*) (rbound 0))))

; Arg J of slot I of TX from SRC: :value (the integer VALUE), :event (the
; member's commit position, written at bind; an insert's integer field, or a
; fold arg its :set copies straight into a value field, fn2-fold-event-field), or
; :out (VALUE = K * 2^8 + F: integer field F of slot K < I's staged row;
; never a fold's key arg, which resolve must read),
; or :new (VALUE = K: 1 when slot K < I staged fresh, 0 when it binds
; nothing; never a fold's key arg; C §4a). An assigned arg takes no call. B0 is TX's stripe base. :ok, :bounds,
; :state, :kind.
(defun fn2-succ-arg (tx i j src value b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)

                                             fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((mv code s sid kcode n) (fn2-succ-declared tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                    (natp j) (< j n) (< j *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (natp b0)
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 value)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (kw (fn2-succ-kindkw kcode))
      (insert (equal kcode *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)) (depend (equal kcode *fn2-succ-kind-depend*))
      (fold (not (or insert depend)))
      ((when (or (and (or insert depend) (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid j)) (and depend (not (eq src :value))) (and fold (fn2-fold-assigned-p sid kw j))
                 (and fold (fn2-succ-octet-field sid kcode j))))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ;; :out VALUE is K*256+F; :new VALUE is the slot K.
      (k (if (eq src :new) value (floor value 256))) (f (if (eq src :new) 0 (mod value 256)))
      (ks (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) k))
      ((unless (case src
                (:value t)
                (:event (or insert (and fold (natp (fn2-fold-event-field sid kw j)))))
                (:new (and (< k i) (< ks (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                           (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase ks fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                           (not (and fold (fn2-succ-key-arg-p (fn2-run-layout-keys sid) 0 sid kw j)))))
                (:out (and (< k i) (< ks (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                           (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase ks fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                           (< f (fn2-run-layout-fields (fn2-succ-slots-sid ks fn2-succ-slots) 0))
                           (not (fn2-run-layout-octets-max (fn2-succ-slots-sid ks fn2-succ-slots) f))
                           (not (and fold (fn2-succ-key-arg-p (fn2-run-layout-keys sid) 0 sid kw j)))))
                (otherwise nil)))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (row (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i) *fn2-succ-raw* j))
      ((unless (< row (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (bit (fn2-succ-bit j))
      (set (logior (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-set s fn2-succ-slots)) bit))
      (events (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-events s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      (outs (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-outs s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      (late (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-late s fn2-succ-slots)) (- #xffffffff bit)))
      ;; (:new K) is an :out of slot K's fresh row.
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put row (value (case src (:event 0) (:new (+ (* 256 k) *fn2-succ-fresh*)) (otherwise value)))
                                  (ref-len 0)))
      ((mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
       (fn2-succ-touch tx s set (if (eq src :event) (logior events bit) events)
                       (if (member-eq src '(:out :new)) (logior outs bit) outs) late
                       fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)))
  (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; Resolve (at :prepare): for every slot that reads its key's row (a fold's,
; or a :unique insert whose key args are all :value), the key's newest row
; in the installed runs, newest run first, into the slot's +36 rows, and the
; schema's run version, which stage compares. Bounded: one run selection or
; one lookup step per call. TX's run cursor is its decision's (cursor row
; TX), so a decision in progress refuses :state.

; The key fields of slot S's row at ENTRY from its args at SRC: a fold's
; key arg for each key field, an insert's first NK args.
(defun fn2-succ-key-rows (k kf nk sid kw insert src entry fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-fields :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp k) (natp kf) (natp src) (natp entry))))
 (if (or (zp k) (not (and (natp kf) (natp nk) (< kf nk)))) fn2-fields
  (let ((a (if insert kf (fn2-fold-key-arg sid kw kf))))
   (if (not (and (natp a) (natp src) (natp entry) (< (+ src a) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (< (+ entry kf) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       fn2-fields
    (let ((fn2-fields (if (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid kf)
                          (fn2-succ-copy-row (+ src a) (+ entry kf) fn2-fields)
                        (fn2-fields-put (+ entry kf) (value (fn2-fields-value (+ src a) fn2-fields)) (ref-len 0)))))
     (fn2-succ-key-rows (- k 1) (+ 1 kf) nk sid kw insert src entry fn2-fields))))))
(fn2-fields-preserves fn2-succ-key-rows (k kf nk sid kw insert src entry fn2-fields) :position nil :raw-rows t
 :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-fold-key-arg))))
; Whether slot S reads its key's row: a fold's or a dependency's (its key
; args are :value by arg's rule), or a :unique insert's whose key args are all given as values.
(defun fn2-succ-reads-key (s fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-succ-slots :guard (and (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)))))
 (let* ((sid (fn2-succ-slots-sid s fn2-succ-slots)) (code (fn2-succ-slots-kind s fn2-succ-slots))
        (nk (nfix (fn2-run-layout-keys sid))) (mask (- (ash 1 nk) 1)))
  (cond ((equal code *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)
         (and (member-eq (fn2-run-layout-merge sid) '(:unique :union))
              (equal (logand (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-set s fn2-succ-slots)) mask) mask)
              (equal (logand (logior (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-events s fn2-succ-slots)) (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-outs s fn2-succ-slots))) mask) 0)))
        (t t))))
; The live run of SID with the greatest identifier below BOUND, among rows
; R.. (K of them); BEST the best so far (a row, or the row count).
(defun fn2-succ-newest-run (k r sid bound best fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-run-installed :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (natp k) (natp r))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp r) (< r (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed)))) best
  (let ((run (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed)))
   (fn2-succ-newest-run (- k 1) (+ 1 r) sid bound
                        (if (and (equal (fn2-run-installed-state r fn2-run-installed) *fn2-run-installed-state-live*)
                                 (equal (fn2-run-installed-schema r fn2-run-installed) sid) (< (nfix run) (nfix bound))
                                 (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))))
                                     (< (nfix (fn2-run-installed-run best fn2-run-installed)) (nfix run))))
                            r best)
                        fn2-run-installed))))

;; The stream members of published batch B (E's fn2-commit-stream-wake,
;; attached to B's hook right after fn2-successor-publish, before any
;; transaction of B is released): its fn2-addr writes, one per call. Cursor
;; I = tx * W + slot walks the transaction rows bound to B (now :published)
;; and their non-empty addr slots, reading the staged row (its position the
;; member's commit position, filled at bind). An addr entry is a position in
;; its principal's own addr stream (e-surface.md 7), the stream a served
;; registration reads and parks on, so the member's stream is the entry's
;; principal (the entry's stream field is the stream it was selected through,
;; an item's detail). (mv code stream position next):
;; :ok with the entry's principal and position and the cursor of the next call;
;; :done past the last; :state when the tables are not well formed. At most
;; K slots visited per call (the whole table: W x t, a profile bound).
(defconst *fn2-succ-addr-sid* 4)
(defun fn2-succ-stream-scan (k i b fcrows fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :measure (nfix k)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (natp i))))
 (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp i) (< i (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)))) (mv :done 0 0 0))
      (tx (floor i *fn2-succ-slots*)) (j (mod i *fn2-succ-slots*))
      ((unless (and (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns))
                    (equal (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns) *fn2-succ-phase-published*)
                    (equal (fn2-succ-txns-batch tx fn2-succ-txns) b)
                    (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase i fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                    (equal (fn2-succ-slots-sid i fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-addr-sid*)))
       (fn2-succ-stream-scan (- k 1) (+ 1 i) b fcrows fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
      ((mv c b0) (fn2-idc-stripe tx fcrows fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
      ((unless (eq c :ok)) (mv c 0 0 0))
      (entry (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* j)))
      ((unless (and (< (+ entry *fn2-addr-entry-field-principal*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (< (+ entry *fn2-addr-entry-field-position*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       (mv :bounds 0 0 0)))
  (mv :ok (fn2-fields-value (+ entry *fn2-addr-entry-field-principal*) fn2-fields)
      (fn2-fields-value (+ entry *fn2-addr-entry-field-position*) fn2-fields) (+ 1 i))))
(defun fn2-succ-stream-member (b i fcrows fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (if (not (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)
               (posp b) (natp i)))
     (mv :state 0 0 0)
   (fn2-succ-stream-scan (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots) i b fcrows fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)))
(defun fn2-succ-stream-member-children (b i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields fn2-fc)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields fn2-fc) :guard t))

     (fn2-succ-stream-member b i (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
   (mv :state 0 0 0)))

; slot of TX, in slot order, into [WOFF, WOFF + WMAX) of WSLOT/WGEN (under
; OKIND OSLOT OGEN). Returns (mv code len fn2-fields fn2-pool) with CODE in
; (:ok :room :state :bounds).
(defun fn2-succ-emit-slot (i s b0 wslot wgen woff wmax len okind oslot ogen fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool)
              (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) (natp i) (natp b0) (natp woff) (natp wmax) (natp len))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-format-txn-record-size fn2-format-txn-record-encode
                                            fn2-run-layout-size fn2-run-layout-encode fn2-fields-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp s) (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*)
                    (natp b0) (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (natp woff) (natp wmax) (natp len)))
       (mv :bounds (nfix len) fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((when (or (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*)
                 (equal (fn2-succ-slots-unchanged s fn2-succ-slots) 1)))
       (mv :ok len fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (sid (fn2-succ-slots-sid s fn2-succ-slots))
      ((unless (and (posp sid) (<= (+ *fn2-commit-txn-schema-record-kind-base* sid) *fn2-commit-txn-schema-record-kind-last*)))
       (mv :bounds len fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (entry (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i)))
      (fbase (+ b0 *fn2-idc-ident*))
      (rlen (fn2-run-layout-size sid 0 entry fn2-fields))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 60 rlen))
       (mv :bounds len fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      (rkind (+ *fn2-commit-txn-schema-record-kind-base* sid))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ fbase *fn2-format-txn-record-field-record-kind*) rkind fn2-fields))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-set-value (+ fbase *fn2-format-txn-record-field-length*) rlen fn2-fields))
      (hlen (fn2-format-txn-record-size fbase fn2-fields))
      (need (+ hlen rlen))
      ((when (< wmax (+ len need)))
       (mv :room len fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (and (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ woff len))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ woff len hlen))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 (+ woff len need))))
       (mv :bounds len fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((mv c1 & fn2-pool)
       (fn2-format-txn-record-encode fbase wslot wgen (+ woff len) okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq c1 :ok))
       (mv :bounds len fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((mv c2 & fn2-pool)
       (fn2-run-layout-encode sid 0 entry wslot wgen (+ woff len hlen) okind oslot ogen fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq c2 :ok))
       (mv :bounds len fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
  (mv :ok (+ len need) fn2-fields fn2-pool)))

; The stage-side wrappers, in their own assembly book (assembly-callbacks-c-
; commit): the one-minute rule (C-SUCCESSOR-BOOK).
;; A hook's attachment. Each constraint of the hook is proved of the
;; attachment by itself: the hook's -CONSTRAINT and -RESULT-CONSP (FN's
;; definition opened, its KIDS contract used), its KIDS by FN's contract and,
;; where the hook keeps the stored owners (commit.lisp
;; fn2-commit-hook-owners-claim), that by FN's owner chain (dispatch-held.lisp)
;; at the commit kind; the defattach then only cites them.
(defun fn2-succ-frame-nths (ks free out)
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (if (atom ks) nil
  (cons `(:instance fn2-arm-kids-nth (i 0) (k ,(car ks)) (free ',free) (a fn2-core) (b ,out))
        (fn2-succ-frame-nths (cdr ks) free out))))
(defun fn2-succ-constraint-hints (hook fn world)
 ; the hook's -CONSTRAINT of FN from FN's preservation lemmas and its KIDS
 ; contract (the frame children are outside its children), FN closed
 (declare (xargs :verify-guards nil))
 (let ((free (fn2-arm-frame-indices (cdr (assoc-eq hook *fn2-commit-hook-children*)) world))
       (out `(mv-nth 1 (,fn ,@(formals hook world)))))
  `(("Goal" :in-theory (union-theories '(,@*fn2-commit-hook-frame* ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-PRESERVES-TYPE")
                                         ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-PRESERVES-WFP"))
                                       (theory 'fn2-arm-frame-base))
     :use ((:instance ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-ARM-KIDS") (fn2-arm-free ',free) (fn2-arm-c0 fn2-core))
           (:instance fn2-arm-kids-refl (i 0) (free ',free) (a fn2-core))
           ,@(fn2-succ-frame-nths (fn2-arm-frame-indices *fn2-commit-hook-frame* world) free out))))))
(defun fn2-succ-attach-lemmas (names hook fn world)

  (let* ((thm (getpropc (fn2-columns-sym hook (car names)) 'untranslated-theorem nil world))
         (name (fn2-columns-sym fn (concatenate 'string "-HOOK" (car names))))
         (opened `(defthm ,name ,(subst fn hook thm)
                   :hints (("Goal" :in-theory (enable ,fn) :use ((:instance ,(fn2-columns-sym fn "-ARM-KIDS")))))
                   :rule-classes nil)))
   (cons (if (equal (car names) "-CONSTRAINT")
             `(make-event '(:or (defthm ,name ,(subst fn hook thm) :hints ,(fn2-succ-constraint-hints hook fn world)
                                  :rule-classes nil)
                                ,opened))
           opened)

    (mv-let (c b0) (fn2-idc-stripe tx (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) fn2-id-decides fn2-fields)
     (if (eq c :ok)
         (fn2-succ-bind tx batch event b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index
                        fn2-fields fn2-pool)
       (mv c fn2-succ-txns fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))))
   (fn2-succ-wrap fn2-successor-release (tx)
    ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-core)) (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-core-succ-slots fn2-core))
     (fn2-id-decides (fn2-core-id-decides fn2-core)))
    (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides)
    (fn2-succ-release tx fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides))
   (fn2-succ-wrap fn2-succ-core-publish (batch)
    ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-core)) (fn2-overlays (fn2-core-overlays fn2-core))
     (fn2-id-engine (fn2-core-id-engine fn2-core)))
    (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-id-engine)
    (fn2-succ-publish batch fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-id-engine))
   ;; The greatest published commit position: (mv code position).
   (defun fn2-successor-stream-member (b i fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (stobj-let ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-core)) (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-core-succ-slots fn2-core))
                (fn2-id-decides (fn2-core-id-decides fn2-core)) (fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-fc (fn2-core-fc fn2-core)))
     (code stream position next)
     (fn2-succ-stream-member-children b i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-fields fn2-fc)
     (mv code stream position next)))
   (defun fn2-successor-published (fn2-core)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-core :guard (fn2-core-wfp fn2-core)))
    (stobj-let ((fn2-id-engine (fn2-core-id-engine fn2-core)))
     (code position) (fn2-succ-published fn2-id-engine) (mv code position)))
   (fn2-succ-wrap fn2-succ-core-drop (batch)
    ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-core)) (fn2-overlays (fn2-core-overlays fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core)))
    (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-pool)
    (fn2-succ-drop batch fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-pool))
   ;; Restore account incarnations and :configured state for any replayed
   ;; fn2-principals (sid 16) slot so post-recovery principal-bind and
   ;; principal-create see every durably created principal's slot as live.
   (defun fn2-succ-replay-accounts (k i tx b0 fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-accounts)
    (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-accounts) :measure (nfix k)
     :guard (and (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)
                 (fn2-accountsp fn2-accounts) (fn2-accounts-wfp fn2-accounts)
                 (natp k) (natp i) (natp tx) (natp b0))
     :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-fields-rows fn2-accounts-rows)))))
    (b* (((unless (and (posp k) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*) (natp tx) (natp b0))) fn2-accounts)
         (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i))
         (entry (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i)))
         ((unless (and (< s (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                       (< (+ entry *fn2-principals-entry-field-principal*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
          fn2-accounts)
         (fn2-accounts
          (if (and (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                   (equal (fn2-succ-slots-sid s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-principals-replay-sid*))
              (let* ((pid (nfix (fn2-fields-value (+ entry *fn2-principals-entry-field-principal*) fn2-fields)))
                     (aslot (floor pid 4294967296))
                     (ainc (mod pid 4294967296)))
               (if (and (< 0 aslot) (< (+ 1 aslot) (fn2-accounts-rows fn2-accounts))
                        (posp ainc) (<= ainc *fn2-account-u32-max*))
                   (let* ((cur (nfix (fn2-accounts-incarnation aslot fn2-accounts)))
                          (fn2-accounts (if (< cur ainc) (fn2-accounts-set-incarnation aslot ainc fn2-accounts) fn2-accounts)))
                    (if (equal (fn2-accounts-state aslot fn2-accounts) *fn2-account-state-free*)
                        (fn2-accounts-set-state aslot *fn2-account-state-configured* fn2-accounts)
                      fn2-accounts))
                 fn2-accounts))
            fn2-accounts)))
     (fn2-succ-replay-accounts (- k 1) (+ 1 i) tx b0 fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-accounts)))
   (fn2-accounts-preserves fn2-succ-replay-accounts (k i tx b0 fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-accounts) :position nil :raw-rows t)
   (in-theory (disable fn2-succ-replay-accounts))
   ;; M7's replay (B's fn2-member-replay): the rows of batches replayed and
   ;; published before are released, then the member binds into a free
   ;; transaction row. BATCH 0 names no batch: the replay's end, which
   ;; releases the last published batch's rows and binds nothing.
   (fn2-succ-wrap fn2-succ-core-replay (batch event slot gen len okind oslot ogen)
    ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-core-succ-txns fn2-core)) (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-core-succ-slots fn2-core))
     (fn2-id-decides (fn2-core-id-decides fn2-core)) (fn2-id-engine (fn2-core-id-engine fn2-core))
     (fn2-overlays (fn2-core-overlays fn2-core)) (fn2-overlay-index (fn2-core-overlay-index fn2-core))
     (fn2-fields (fn2-core-fields fn2-core)) (fn2-pool (fn2-core-pool fn2-core))
     (fn2-accounts (fn2-core-accounts fn2-core)) (fn2-fc (fn2-core-fc fn2-core)))
    (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-accounts)
    (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-id-decides-wfp fn2-id-decides)
                       (fn2-accountsp fn2-accounts) (fn2-accounts-wfp fn2-accounts)))
          (mv :state fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-accounts))
         ((mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides)
          (fn2-succ-replay-sweep (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns) 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides))
         ((unless (and (eq code :ok) (posp batch)))
          (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-accounts))
         ;; a transaction row (one with write slots), never a read row's
         (tx (fn2-succ-replay-free (floor (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) *fn2-succ-slots*) 0 fn2-succ-txns))
         ((unless (< tx (floor (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots)) *fn2-succ-slots*)))
          (mv :full fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-accounts))
         ((mv c b0) (fn2-idc-stripe tx (fn2-fc-rows fn2-fc) fn2-id-decides fn2-fields))
         ((unless (eq c :ok))
          (mv c fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-accounts))
         ((mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
          (fn2-succ-replay tx batch event slot gen len okind oslot ogen b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots
                           fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))
         (fn2-accounts (if (eq code :ok)
                           (fn2-succ-replay-accounts *fn2-succ-slots* 0 tx b0 fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields fn2-accounts)
                         fn2-accounts)))
     (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-id-decides fn2-id-engine fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool fn2-accounts)))
   ; B5-4: publish and drop are B's constrained hooks; these are their attachments.
   ; Each proves the hook's frame (commit.lisp *fn2-commit-hook-children*) by its
   ; own contract at those children, which its defcost's :tables cover.
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-commit-hook-attach-events 'fn2-successor-publish 'fn2-succ-core-publish (w state)))))
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-commit-hook-attach-events 'fn2-successor-drop 'fn2-succ-core-drop (w state)))))
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-dh-chain-forms-m (fn2-dh-postorder-m '(fn2-succ-core-publish) :owners (w state)) nil :owners))))
   (make-event (value (fn2-succ-attach-form 'fn2-successor-publish 'fn2-succ-core-publish (w state))))
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-dh-chain-forms-m (fn2-dh-postorder-m '(fn2-succ-core-drop) :owners (w state)) nil :owners))))
   (make-event (value (fn2-succ-attach-form 'fn2-successor-drop 'fn2-succ-core-drop (w state))))
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-commit-hook-attach-events 'fn2-member-replay 'fn2-succ-core-replay (w state)))))
   (make-event (value (cons 'progn (fn2-dh-chain-forms-m (fn2-dh-postorder-m '(fn2-succ-core-replay) :owners (w state)) nil :owners))))
   (make-event (value (fn2-succ-attach-form 'fn2-member-replay 'fn2-succ-core-replay (w state))))
   (in-theory (disable fn2-successor-stage fn2-successor-out fn2-successor-applied fn2-successor-fill-octets fn2-successor-emit fn2-successor-bind fn2-successor-release fn2-succ-core-publish fn2-successor-published fn2-successor-stream-member fn2-succ-core-drop fn2-succ-core-replay))
   (assert-event (fn2-assert-compliant-p '(fn2-successor-stage fn2-successor-out fn2-successor-applied fn2-successor-fill-octets fn2-successor-emit fn2-successor-bind fn2-successor-release fn2-succ-core-publish fn2-successor-published fn2-successor-stream-member fn2-succ-core-drop fn2-succ-core-replay) (w state)))))
before.machines-c-groups:
; Layer C in the served core, seams S-GROUP and the exact lookup it stands on
; (docs/c-ordered-runs.md §8 item 9): the group directory's genesis from
; the profile's :groups list, the exact lookup of a key over a schema's
; published overlays and installed runs, newest first, and the identity
; decision (§4a) as two such lookups. A lookup is
; resumable: one source (one overlay, or one bounded run step) per call, its
; continuation in the transaction's row (LPHASE LBOUND LROW LVER), its query
; in the transaction's lookup area (+4), its decoded entries in the
; run reader rows (+84), its run cursor the transaction's. So it is called at
; :prepare while the transaction's identity decision is idle or done and
; resolve is not inside a run descent (:state otherwise). The genesis, the
; defcosts and the core wrappers (fn2-groups-core-events and
; fn2-identity-core-events, materialized in assembly-callbacks-c.lisp) are
; this book's.
(in-package "ACL2")
(include-book "machines-c-bind")
(fn2-book-layer :c)
(local (in-theory (disable fn2-run-layout-fields fn2-run-layout-keys fn2-run-layout-merge fn2-run-layout-size
                           fn2-fold-key-arg fn2-fold-arity fn2-fold-assigned-p fn2-run-layout-octets-max
                           fn2-run-layout-value-ok fn2-run-layout-fold-p fn2-run-version)))

(defconst *fn2-groups-sid* 8)
(defconst *fn2-groups-name-max* 250)
(assert-event (and (equal *fn2-groups-entry-field-name* 0) (equal *fn2-groups-entry-field-group* 1)))

; ---------------------------------------------------------------------------
; The exact lookup. The published overlay of SID (frozen) with the greatest
; SEQ below BOUND among rows O.. (K of them); BEST the row count when none.
(defun fn2-xl-newest-frozen (k o sid bound best fn2-overlays)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-overlays :measure (nfix k) :guard (and (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (natp o))))
 (if (not (and (posp k) (natp o) (< o (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays)))) best
  (fn2-xl-newest-frozen (- k 1) (+ 1 o) sid bound
                        (if (and (equal (fn2-overlays-phase o fn2-overlays) *fn2-overlay-phase-frozen*)
                                 (equal (fn2-overlays-schema o fn2-overlays) sid)
                                 (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)) (nfix bound))
                                 (or (not (and (natp best) (< best (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))))
                                     (< (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq best fn2-overlays)) (nfix (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays)))))
                            o best)
                        fn2-overlays)))
(defthm fn2-xl-newest-frozen-natp
 (implies (natp best) (natp (fn2-xl-newest-frozen k o sid bound best fn2-overlays))) :rule-classes :type-prescription)
(in-theory (disable fn2-xl-newest-frozen))

; Restart TX's lookup from the newest overlay, noting SID's run version.
(defun fn2-xl-restart (tx sid fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed))))
 (b* ((version (fn2-run-version sid (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed) fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (unsigned-byte-p 60 version)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-overlays*) (lbound *fn2-u60-max*) (lrow 0) (lver version))))
  (mv :more fn2-succ-txns)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-restart (tx sid fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed) (fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed))

; Done: TX's lookup idles.
(defun fn2-xl-done (tx code fn2-succ-txns)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs fn2-succ-txns :guard (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns)))
 (if (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)))
     (let ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-idle*) (lbound 0) (lrow 0) (lver 0))))
      (mv code fn2-succ-txns))
   (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-done (tx code fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-txns))

; The overlay leg: the newest published overlay below the bound holding the
; query's key answers with its entry decoded at RB; else the bound moves
; below it, and past the last overlay the run leg starts. (mv code found
; txns fields)
(defun fn2-xl-overlay (tx sid qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index)
              (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-fields-rows fn2-overlays-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp qb) (natp rb)
                    (<= (+ qb *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (<= (+ rb *fn2-run-entry-rows*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       (mv :bounds nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields))
      (rows (fn2-overlays-rows fn2-overlays))
      (o (fn2-xl-newest-frozen rows 0 sid (fn2-succ-txns-lbound tx fn2-succ-txns) rows fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (< o rows))
       (let ((fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-runs*) (lbound *fn2-u60-max*))))
        (mv :more nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields)))
      ((mv code pos order fn2-fields) (fn2-ov-locate o rb qb qk qs qg fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields))
      ((when (eq order :eq))
       (b* (((mv code & fn2-fields) (fn2-ov-entry o pos rb fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)))
        (mv code (eq code :ok) fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields)))
      (seq (fn2-overlays-seq o fn2-overlays))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 60 seq)) (mv :bounds nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-set-lbound tx seq fn2-succ-txns)))
  (mv :more nil fn2-succ-txns fn2-fields)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-overlay (tx sid qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 ((fn2-succ-txns 2) (fn2-fields 3)) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-fields fn2-pool) t
 (fn2-xl-newest-frozen fn2-ov-locate fn2-ov-entry fn2-succ-txns-lbound fn2-overlays-seq))

; The run leg, between runs: start the cursor in the newest live run of SID
; below the bound, or answer :absent past the last.
(defun fn2-xl-run-next (tx sid rb fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-run-cursor-start fn2-xl-done)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp rb)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors))
      (rows (fn2-run-installed-rows fn2-run-installed))
      (r (fn2-succ-newest-run rows 0 sid (fn2-succ-txns-lbound tx fn2-succ-txns) rows fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (natp r) (< r rows)))
       (mv-let (code fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-xl-done tx :absent fn2-succ-txns) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors)))
      ((mv code fn2-run-cursors)
       (fn2-run-cursor-start tx sid (fn2-run-installed-top r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-slot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-gen r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-unit r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-counter r fn2-run-installed) rb
                             (fn2-run-installed-okind r fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-installed-oslot r fn2-run-installed)
                             (fn2-run-installed-ogen r fn2-run-installed) fn2-run-cursors))
      ((unless (eq code :ok)) (mv code fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors))
      (run (fn2-run-installed-run r fn2-run-installed))
      ((unless (and (unsigned-byte-p 60 run) (unsigned-byte-p 32 r))) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors))
      (fn2-succ-txns (fn2-succ-txns-put tx (lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-scan*) (lbound run) (lrow r))))
  (mv :more fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors)))
(fn2-idc-fn-shape fn2-xl-run-next (tx sid rb fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors)
 (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors) t
 (fn2-succ-newest-run fn2-run-cursor-start fn2-xl-done fn2-succ-txns-lbound fn2-run-installed-run
  fn2-run-installed-top fn2-run-installed-slot fn2-run-installed-gen fn2-run-installed-unit fn2-run-installed-counter
  fn2-run-installed-okind fn2-run-installed-oslot fn2-run-installed-ogen))

; One call of TX's lookup of the key at QB (owner QK QS QG) in SID: :ok with
; the entry decoded at the returned row, :absent, :more (call again), :miss
; (a run page to load), or a refusal. A run version that moved while the
; lookup was in the run leg restarts it from the newest overlay (a fact
; that moved from an overlay already passed into a new run is met again).
; (mv code erow txns cursors paths fields)
(defun fn2-xl-step (tx sid budget qb rb qk qs qg fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed
                    fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-overlays fn2-overlay-index fn2-run-installed fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths
                          fn2-run-cache fn2-fields fn2-pool)
  :guard (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-overlays-wfp fn2-overlays) (fn2-overlay-index-wfp fn2-overlay-index)
              (fn2-run-installed-wfp fn2-run-installed) (fn2-run-cursors-wfp fn2-run-cursors) (fn2-run-paths-wfp fn2-run-paths)
              (fn2-run-cache-wfp fn2-run-cache) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields) (fn2-pool-wfp fn2-pool) (natp budget))
  :guard-hints (("Goal" :in-theory (disable fn2-xl-restart fn2-xl-done fn2-xl-overlay fn2-xl-run-next fn2-run-lookup-step
                                            fn2-fields-rows fn2-succ-txns-rows)))))
 (b* (((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp rb) (natp qb)))
       (mv :bounds 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields))
      (lphase (fn2-succ-txns-lphase tx fn2-succ-txns)))
  (cond
   ((equal lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-idle*)
    (mv-let (code fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-xl-restart tx sid fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-installed)
     (mv code 0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-run-cursors fn2-run-paths fn2-fields)))
   ((equal lphase *fn2-succ-lookup-overlays*)

      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*) (natp f) (natp b0)
                    (< (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i) (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))))
       (mv :bounds 0))
      ((unless (member (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns)
                       (list *fn2-succ-phase-staged* *fn2-succ-phase-bound* *fn2-succ-phase-published*)))
       (mv :state 0))
      (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i)) (sid (fn2-succ-slots-sid s fn2-succ-slots))
      ((when (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*)) (mv :state 0))
      ((unless (< f (min *fn2-succ-fields-max* (fn2-run-layout-fields sid 0)))) (mv :bounds 0))
      ((when (fn2-run-layout-octets-max sid f)) (mv :kind 0)))
  (if (< (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i) f) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
      (mv :ok (fn2-fields-value (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i) f) fn2-fields))
    (mv :bounds 0))))

; Whether fold slot I of TX applied at its last stage: (mv code verdict),
; verdict :applied, or :unchanged when its event's :when failed under
; :unless-when :unchanged (the slot binds nothing). :state unless TX has
; staged and the slot is in use; :kind for an insert slot.
(defun fn2-succ-applied (tx i fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots) :guard t))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots))) (mv :state nil))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*)
                    (< (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i) (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))))
       (mv :bounds nil))
      ((unless (member (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns)
                       (list *fn2-succ-phase-staged* *fn2-succ-phase-bound* *fn2-succ-phase-published*)))
       (mv :state nil))
      (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i)) (kcode (fn2-succ-slots-kind s fn2-succ-slots))
      ((when (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*)) (mv :state nil))
      ((when (equal kcode *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)) (mv :kind nil)))
  (mv :ok (if (equal (fn2-succ-slots-unchanged s fn2-succ-slots) 1) :unchanged :applied))))

; Fill late octet arg J of insert slot I of TX (C-S3a): LEN octets at [OFF,
; OFF+LEN) of SLOT/GEN, readable under OKIND OSLOT OGEN until bind (every
; octet arg of a slot under one owner: :owner). TX must be :staged (else
; :state: a later stage needs the fill again); J a late arg of the slot
; (else :kind); LEN at most the declared bound (else :bounds). The staged
; entry row takes the reference; TX stays :staged and its room is unchanged
; (stage counted the bound).
(defun fn2-succ-fill-octets (tx i j slot gen off len okind oslot ogen b0 fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)
 (declare (xargs :stobjs (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) :guard t))
 (b* (((unless (and (fn2-succ-txns-wfp fn2-succ-txns) (fn2-succ-slots-wfp fn2-succ-slots) (fn2-fields-wfp fn2-fields)))
       (mv :state fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (and (natp tx) (< tx (fn2-succ-txns-rows fn2-succ-txns)) (natp i) (< i *fn2-succ-slots*)
                    (natp j) (< j *fn2-succ-fields-max*) (natp b0)
                    (< (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i) (fn2-succ-slots-rows fn2-succ-slots))
                    (<= (+ b0 *fn2-idc-stride*) (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields))
                    (unsigned-byte-p 32 slot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 gen) (unsigned-byte-p 32 off) (unsigned-byte-p 32 len)
                    (unsigned-byte-p 8 okind) (unsigned-byte-p 32 oslot) (unsigned-byte-p 60 ogen)))
       (mv :bounds fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (equal (fn2-succ-txns-phase tx fn2-succ-txns) *fn2-succ-phase-staged*)) (mv :state fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (s (+ (* tx *fn2-succ-slots*) i))
      (bit (fn2-succ-bit j))
      ((unless (and (not (equal (fn2-succ-slots-phase s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-slot-phase-empty*))
                    (equal (fn2-succ-slots-kind s fn2-succ-slots) *fn2-succ-kind-insert*)
                    (fn2-succ-has (fn2-succ-slots-late s fn2-succ-slots) j)))
       (mv :kind fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (raw (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i) *fn2-succ-raw* j)) (row (+ b0 (* *fn2-succ-block* i) j))
      ((unless (and (< raw (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)) (< row (fn2-fields-rows fn2-fields)))) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((unless (<= len (nfix (fn2-fields-ref-len raw fn2-fields)))) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      ((when (and (equal (fn2-succ-slots-oset s fn2-succ-slots) 1)
                  (not (and (equal (fn2-succ-slots-sk s fn2-succ-slots) okind) (equal (fn2-succ-slots-ss s fn2-succ-slots) oslot)
                            (equal (fn2-succ-slots-sg s fn2-succ-slots) ogen)))))
       (mv :owner fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (filled (logior (nfix (fn2-succ-slots-filled s fn2-succ-slots)) bit))
      ((unless (unsigned-byte-p 32 filled)) (mv :bounds fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields))
      (fn2-fields (fn2-fields-put row (value 0) (ref-slot slot) (ref-gen gen) (ref-off off) (ref-len len)))
      (fn2-succ-slots (fn2-succ-slots-put s (oset 1) (sk okind) (ss oslot) (sg ogen) (filled filled))))
  (mv :ok fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields)))

 (fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) (fn2-succ-txns fn2-succ-slots fn2-fields) t
 (fn2-succ-txns-phase fn2-succ-slots-phase fn2-succ-slots-kind fn2-succ-slots-late fn2-succ-slots-filled fn2-succ-slots-oset
